name: Tracing the Source
label: Quest
description: Tracing the Source: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We must find who the supplier is. I noticed Apothecary Katrina with a bottle of the perfume tucked in her pack. She told me that she purchased it from Norman, the innkeeper.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah yes, I just recently received stock of the perfume and cologne. I don't know how long I can keep it on the shelves - seems like no one can get enough of it.
If you ask me, I don't see what the big deal is.
